catalogs.name: Moon: illumination provenance fixture (#204)
catalogs.description: lro-moon with the WAC+NAC cube layer explicitly declared illumination "baked" (opt-in; shipped demos keep undeclared provenance, which renders as before). Baked pixels show as-is with only a terminator gate. Compare with lro-moon in Natural, Shadow and Flood and across epochs. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/surface-illumination.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: cube sphere + NAC, adoption check (#149)
catalogs.description: The initial production configuration under evaluation: full-lattice cube-sphere terrain with the main-view draw cull (default for cube products), LROC NAC cube imagery, and a nadir-pointing orbiter sensor over Shackleton for main/instrument view switching. Driven by scripts/capture-cube-imagery.mjs --experiments adoption; experimental, not listed in the catalog index.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: cube sphere + diagnostic grid fixture (#149 imagery experiment)
catalogs.description: Synthetic diagnostic imagery: graticules, face edges and bullseye markers, draped by CubeImageryLayer at its own levels on the cube-sphere terrain (scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube.sh). Build the imagery with scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube-imagery.sh. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: cube sphere + LROC NAC south-pole mosaic (#149 imagery experiment)
catalogs.description: LROC NAC South Pole controlled mosaic (1 m source), cube-face pyramid, draped by CubeImageryLayer at its own levels on the cube-sphere terrain (scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube.sh). Build the imagery with scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube-imagery.sh. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: cube sphere + registration fixture (#149 imagery experiment)
catalogs.description: Synthetic texel-coordinate encoding for registration read-back, draped by CubeImageryLayer at its own levels on the cube-sphere terrain (scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube.sh). Build the imagery with scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube-imagery.sh. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: cube sphere (#149 experiment)
catalogs.description: Gnomonic cube-sphere 3D Tiles of the fused LOLA field, with CPU height grids. Build: scripts/build-moon-terrain/cube.sh. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: geographic baseline (#48)
catalogs.description: Geographic quantized-mesh pyramid of the same fused field. Build: scripts/build-moon-terrain/fused.sh (~11 GB). Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Moon terrain: polar cap baseline (#145)
catalogs.description: Square-tile south-polar cap of the same fused field (no CPU sampler). Build: scripts/build-moon-terrain/polar.sh. Experimental, not listed in the catalog index; see docs/design/cube-sphere-experiment.md.

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors · Natural Earth countries
catalogs.description: Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 countries 5.1.1, WGS84 geodetic degrees. All 177 source features, including Antarctica and islands. Cyan boundaries/fills; click for gold. Use Display → Viewpoint to change scale.

catalogs.name: Geographic backend comparison · Natural Earth
catalogs.description: Same shared geographic layer and WGS84 imagery-only tile geometry for both vector and upstream raster overlay comparison. See /geographic-compare.html.

catalogs.name: Geographic vector GPU benchmark
catalogs.description: Reproducible scenes for the geographic vector pass's GPU cost (scripts/benchmark-geographic-gpu.mjs): one point, one small polygon and 200 annotations at Jezero, close and whole-disk views.

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors · dense Jezero on measured terrain
catalogs.description: Synthetic 160-vertex polygon and 1,600 targets concentrated around Jezero, draped on the local measured terrain pyramid. Cyan marks should all draw; click a target to highlight it in gold. Requires data/mars-terrain-fused/.

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors · measured Jezero
catalogs.description: Synthetic registration points, traverse and polygon with a hole on measured terrain. Requires the local terrain pyramid; this is not surveyed geology. Use the saved detail, close, regional and orbit viewpoints to compare LOD transitions.

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors on streamed Mars terrain
catalogs.description: A modest set of wide regional polygons and lines around Gale crater over streamed MOLA/HRSC terrain with Viking/CTX imagery (network), for LOD-transition correctness and broad-area GPU cost (scripts/test-geographic-streamed-lod.mjs, scripts/test-geographic-close-zoom.mjs, scripts/benchmark-geographic-gpu.mjs).

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors · measured Shackleton
catalogs.description: Synthetic registration points, traverse and polygon with a hole on measured terrain. Requires the local terrain pyramid; this is not surveyed geology. Use the saved detail, close, regional and orbit viewpoints to compare LOD transitions.

catalogs.name: Geographic vectors · synthetic validation
catalogs.description: Synthetic Jezero science/traverse/regions and lunar polar regions on reference globes. Coordinates are validation fixtures, not surveyed geology or terrain measurements. The surface status identifies the reference-globe fallback.
